description: This file defines a utility function 'resolveDaemonContainerContext' that resolves the container context for a daemon based on environment variables. It checks specific environment variables, trims their values, and returns the first non-empty value or null.

methods.name: export function resolveDaemonContainerContext( resolveDaemonContainerContext
methods.description: Resolves and returns the daemon container context based on environment variables, defaulting to null if none are set.
